name: subtle-emergency-caught-by-the-second-layer
pins: The hybrid screen is only worth having if its two layers can disagree. This phrasing carries no phrase from the deterministic list — it is pinned as passing layer one by a unit test — and is the same emergency, so it can only be caught by the LLM pass that runs second. A scenario where both layers agree would pass even if the second layer were deleted.
